description: M holds 228 rows on 28 data pages in its owned map (page 45 with no live row, page 56 with slot 0 deleted, page 67 one live row, page 80 four), storage order. A table-type recordset over M with no index: PercentPosition and ID at storage rows 0 (page 56 slot 1), 7 (56,8), 8 (57,0), 98 (67,0), 99 (80,5), 102 (80,8), the last row, at EOF and at BOF. Then, on the same recordset, each value [0 ;; 1 ;; 3.5 ;; 3.6 ;; 7.1 ;; 7.2 ;; 42.8 ;; 42.9 ;; 46.4 ;; 46.5 ;; 49.1 ;; 49.2 ;; 50 ;; 99.6 ;; 100 ;; 101 ;; 103.6 ;; 103.7 ;; 150 ;; -1 ;; -3.6] assigned to PercentPosition in turn, reading PercentPosition and ID after each. Then with Index PK_M: PercentPosition and ID after MoveFirst, Move 51, MoveLast, and after assigning 50 and 25. Decides whether the table-type scale is pages of the owned map with the row's ordinal among the page's live rows (24.206348 at row 51 and 99.55357 at the last row in r-cursor-1/pop-count-table), how an assigned value maps back to a page and row, the out-of-range boundary, and the scale under an index. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: R-CURSOR-1 CUR-POS PercentPosition, table-type over M (28 owned data pages, one empty, partial pages): the value moves in steps of 100/28 and assignment lands on page boundaries; the exact rule is not qualified yet.
